name: 2024-1c-parcial2
title: SW-Project
description: A project tracking system where projects are trees of subprojects and concrete tasks with dependencies, effort, desired start dates and a responsible developer or mob-programming team. The student must design it from scratch with TDD, computing start/end dates and a worksheet that reports developer overassignment, overassignment days and total cost.

design.notes: Two composite hierarchies (Project/ConcreteTask and Team/Developer) interact: the task's end date depends on the slowest member of a possibly nested team, start dates depend on dependencies, and the worksheet must aggregate per-developer per-day work across the whole tree using units (hour, day, dollar).
